title: Employ only approved teachers
what: Employ a person as a teacher in a prescribed school only if the person is an approved (registered or permitted) teacher.

sources.title: Education (Queensland College of Teachers) Act 2005 (Qld)
sources.quote: The employing authority for a prescribed school must not employ a person as a teacher in the prescribed school unless the person is an approved teacher.
